reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset and Brown judge Jehoiachin's brief three month vassal reign too slight to count, leaving Jeremiah's oracle against Jehoiakim intact.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Skeptic's Annotated Bible (Steve Wells) catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Skeptic's Annotated Bible (Steve Wells), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (1999).

sides.snippet: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers; and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
sides.verseText: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers; and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

sides.snippet: He shall have none to sit on the throne of David; and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.
sides.verseText: Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: He shall have none to sit on the throne of David; and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.
